messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: page fired: auth-service - jwt_verification_errors > 5% in 60s. Severity: P1. PagerDuty: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345

pagerduty: pagerduty: INC12345 triggered, assigned to 'eng-oncall' escalation policy

maria (eng-oncall): acked. I'm on it — pulling logs now. Sam, can you help triage?

sam (oncall): ack. seeing a spike in 401s from the API gateway. Quick check: earliest spike ~ 2026-03-14T01:00:30Z. 401s all across /v1/generate and identity calls.

kevin (auth): jumping in. Last key rotation was automated via keymanager at 2026-03-14T00:59:40Z. We pushed a new key pair (kid: rot-20260314-2). Tokens issued in the window might still be signed by old key (kid: rot-20260307-1). JWKS should contain both, but maybe old key wasn't published/propagated.

maria (eng-oncall): can you dump the jwks?

kevin (auth): running:

```
curl -sS https://auth.prod.redwood/api/.well-known/jwks.json | jq -c
```

kevin (auth): output snippets:

```
{ "keys": [ { "kid": "rot-20260314-2", "kty": "RSA", ... } ] }
```

kevin (auth): old key missing from JWKS. That would explain the "kid not found" verification errors. logs show:

```
ERROR auth.verify_jwt - InvalidTokenError: No matching JWK for kid rot-20260307-1 - token rejected
```

sam (oncall): confirmed in gateway logs: many entries with `InvalidTokenError: No matching JWK for kid rot-20260307-1`. Percent 401s ~ 8% in last 10m, affecting both hosted API and some dedicated customers.

nora (customer-success): any immediate customer-visible impact? I already got a ping from Acme SRE complaining about 401s.

maria (eng-oncall): impact: authentication failures for requests with tokens signed by the old key. Sessions that didn't refresh tokens during the rotation window are impacted. Rough estimate: 5-12% of requests, some high-traffic customers hit. Escalating to oncall-auth (kevin) for a hotfix.

kevin (auth): quick mitigation plan: 1) re-add old public key to JWKS so verifiers can validate existing tokens; 2) force-jwks-refresh on gateway and auth caches; 3) monitor errors; 4) follow up with safe key rotation procedure.

maria (eng-oncall): agreed. Kevin — can you add the old key to jwks and push? If we need to rollback the rotation, do that after we have a clean signal.

kevin (auth): doing. Pushing JWKS patch now.

```
# auth keymanager adhoc: publish old pubkey
kubectl -n auth exec deploy/keymanager -- curl -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"kid":"rot-20260307-1","kty":"RSA","n":"AAABBB...","e":"AQAB"}' \
  http://localhost:8080/internal/publish_jwk
```

kevin (auth): published. Now triggering caches flush:

```
# restart jwks-cache components
kubectl -n ingress rollout restart deployment/api-gateway
kubectl -n auth rollout restart deployment/auth-cache
```

sam (oncall): executed gateway restart. auth-cache restart in progress.

maria (eng-oncall): patching alert thresholds to avoid noise while we stabilize (lower severity for token refresh storms).

incident-bot: deploy-bot: deploy auth-jwks patch to prod succeeded (deployment id: auth-jwks-patch-20260314-01)

kevin (auth): auth-cache is back up. Doing a quick curl to JWKS from a few region proxies to confirm old kid present.

kevin (auth): verified: JWKS now contains both kids. Replayed a few previously failing tokens against the verifier locally — they validate now.

sam (oncall): errors dropping. 401 rate down from 8% -> 0.7% in last 5m. Customer reports should start clearing.

nora (customer-success): contacting top impacted customers: Acme and BetaCorp. Messaging: "We observed transient auth failures for a subset of requests; root cause was a key propagation issue during an automated key rotation; we deployed a fix at 2026-03-14T01:02:40Z and verified token validation is restored. We'll follow up with a full postmortem."

maria (eng-oncall): good. I'm going to keep monitoring for 15 more minutes; then I'll start a formal incident ticket and assign postmortem. Sam — can you stay until handoff?

sam (oncall): I can stay 15. If it looks stable, I'll hand off to sara (sre) for the overnight.

sara (sre): I'll take it after Sam. Please include all logs and actions in the ticket. I'll look at improving jwks cache TTLs and add instrumentation on jwks-propagation times.

kevin (auth): follow-ups: (a) improve keymanager publish + verify step to double-check JWKS contains old+new before removing old; (b) add telemetry for jwks pushes so we can alert on missing keys; (c) review automation that triggered the rotation in the maintenance window.

maria (eng-oncall): creating incident ticket INC12345-AuthKeyPropagation. Adding timeline and commands.

maria (eng-oncall): note for post-incident: consider rolling rollback path (re-publish old key + 0-downtime cache flush) as approved runbook step.

incident-bot: reminder: please ack PD incident and set status. pagerduty: INC12345 acknowledged by maria (eng-oncall) at 2026-03-14T01:03:10Z

maria (eng-oncall): will prepare a short status update for CS: root cause = JWKS did not contain previous signing key during an automated rotation, causing verification failures for tokens issued before rotation. Mitigation = re-published old key and restarted jwks caches; verification rate returned to normal at ~2026-03-14T01:02:40Z.

nora (customer-success): sending message to customers now.

sam (oncall): handing off to sara at 2026-03-14T01:12:05Z. All pages silenced, monitoring healthy.

sara (sre): acked handoff. I'll own the follow-up and the postmortem draft. Please drop links to any logs or dashboards in the ticket.

maria (eng-oncall): closing thread when stable. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

sara (sre): next steps I'm tracking:
- postmortem draft (due EOD)
- add JWKS propagation checks in deploy pipeline
- reduce automation blast radius for key rotations
- coordinate with security for rotation policy updates

maria (eng-oncall): last note: time of mitigation start 2026-03-14T01:01:30Z, full recovery 2026-03-14T01:02:40Z, total blast window ~70s. Adding to incident ticket.

sam (oncall): thanks all.
